answer: Sampled heartbeat audits. Each key broadcasts a signed pulse every epoch; verifiers shine a prism across the ocean of active keys, drawing a random 1% to re-run one live task and match its output hash and latency against the claim. Because the sample is unpredictable, a sybil operator with 100 clones must keep every clone ready for a genuine re-run - faking full workloads costs real compute each epoch, so fleet farming collapses into honest cost instead of free identity inflation.
